Resolver.SourceUrl: DLIllustr is an internal Delaware Life / Group 1001 illustration tool (DocsCorp DocsCorp-derived InstallShield MSI) with no public download URL. Obtain the current 'DLIllustr v<version>.msi' from the internal software distribution share and stage it in the package Files folder.

Installation.OfflineFallback: Stage the installer in the package Files folder to bypass the download.

Provenance.Notes: OFFLINE-ONLY / INTERNAL. Base DLIllustr product (NOT the Nautilus variant). Current staged media: 'DLIllustr v3.8.0.msi' - ProductName 'DLIllustr v3.8.0', ProductCode {A1DC44AA-97D8-42DA-876C-19275D3AA52D}, UpgradeCode {05B7485E-D6EE-4E89-AE77-E8A26E73B617}, Manufacturer 'Delaware Life', v3.8.0. InstallShield MSI (ARPNOMODIFY=1, built-in downgrade block), installs silently via msiexec with ALLUSERS=1. ProductName embeds the version so detection is '^DLIllustr v' (DisplayName) - this intentionally excludes 'Nautilus-DLIllustr'. For an exact-version gate in Intune use ProductCode {A1DC44AA-97D8-42DA-876C-19275D3AA52D}. The legacy.DL_illustr routine also removed a stale InstallShield key and uninstalled prior versions first; add that cleanup to the package if the fleet still has older builds. No public download URL - media must be staged in Files\.
